note: One entry per CI tag, newest first. Maintained by the Librarian + Journalist in the same commit as CHANGELOG.md — the changelog is the full record, this file is the per-version site view. QA builds are stamped <next-version>-qa.<sha> and never appear here until released.

versions.title: Chat with your materials — and let it do the work
changes: The 💬 chat pane: ask about the voice note you just processed, choosing what goes into each question (transcript, summary, infographic status, costs, earlier turns) with a cost estimate on every row (issue 034)

The chat can operate the tool — a 13-tool registry covering redraw the infographic, run a sample, change a prompt, read costs — with every action shown in the conversation and audited in the debug pane, and hard caps per exchange (8 steps, 2 spending calls, ~20p)
The chat can rewrite the transcript or summary on the page, with the original always one click away, and can see the finished infographic as a real image (issue 035)
Suggestion chips only appear on a blank thread (wa-chat-panel v0.1.1)

versions.title: A page per release, and honest key errors
changes: Versions page: every release we have cut, newest first, with its changes and a link to the exact diff; the version number now sits in every page footer and links to it (issue 033)

Fixed: a disabled or out-of-credit OpenRouter key was reported as a model-side network failure; failures are now checked against your key, which is named in the error and flagged on the key panel (issue 032)
The "also make me an infographic" option is ticked by default, so a plain run returns transcript, summary and infographic
Design brief for the chat pane (issue 034)

versions.title: The infographic becomes a finished image
changes: Infographic default model is now google/gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview — a finished, publication-quality picture instead of a drawn SVG; model picker (two image models + drawn-SVG option) and a redraw button on the card; system prompt editable in the debug pane
Progress heartbeat: spinner + live elapsed counter while drawing, and live timers on in-flight calls in the debug pane
Sample chips load into the options screen (the infographic toggle was unreachable when they auto-ran)
QA estate verified end to end: the qa branch auto-deploys to Netlify with the test gate and an in-job live check (issues 030–031)

versions.title: The advanced debug pane, sample notes, and a tested pipeline
changes: Debug/advanced pane (⚙ tab, resizable): every LLM request and response verbatim, OpenRouter key/model/generation lookups, and all prompt templates editable with browser-stored overrides (issue 027)
Three genuine sample voice notes on the app page — click to load
CI now tests every release: 22 unit tests + a Playwright boot of the real app gate the tag; a live-site QA job runs after each deploy (issue 028)
Fixed: re-running the same voice note failed with a misleading "not-audio" error (issue 029)

versions.title: Deploys can no longer mix old and new code
changes: Fixed stale cached modules after a deploy: CI stamps ?v=<version> onto every same-origin script and stylesheet, so a browser cannot run the previous release's JavaScript against new HTML (issue 026)
Infographic failures now explain themselves instead of failing silently

versions.title: The full one-pass — and a silent transcription bug fixed
changes: M2 shipped: the infographic stage completes the one-pass (transcript → summary → infographic), verified end to end with a real key

Fixed a silent data-integrity bug: some .ogg voice notes reached the model undecodable and came back as hallucinated transcripts — audio is now identified by its actual content, not its filename (issue 025, reported upstream)

versions.title: The product app ships (M1)
changes: Drop a voice note → transcript (about five seconds) → structured summary, streaming in arrival order; bring-your-own OpenRouter key, stored only in your browser; costs shown in GBP
Built by importing the proven audio-transcribe engine cross-origin onto our own whatsapp-transcribe API (the M1-a spike verdict)
Repo debrief covering the 29 Jul – 5 Aug contributions
